<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the config model (`data_avalanche_config::RULES`). Don't edit: change the source and run it again. -->

A config with any **error** is rejected whole: at startup the node refuses to start, and on a reload the running config stays in force. A **warning** is logged and the config loads. `POST /v1/config/validate` runs the same checks without applying anything. Rules marked *error and warning* error outside a hard range and warn outside the recommended one.

| Rule | Severity | Where | Rule text |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="v-001"></span>V-001 | error | `source` | After merge, the engine block matching type is present when that engine has required fields: postgres must be present; an absent mysql block means all defaults. (The foreign block: V-003.) |
| <span id="v-002"></span>V-002 | error | `sink.iceberg.catalog` | Exactly one sub-block (glue/hive/rest); if type is set it must equal the present block. |
| <span id="v-003"></span>V-003 | error | `source.{postgres,mysql}` | Engine block present must match type; the foreign engine block is forbidden. |
| <span id="v-004"></span>V-004 | error | `top` | pipelines key present (may be {}). |
| <span id="v-005"></span>V-005 | error | `top` | globals present. |
| <span id="v-006"></span>V-006 | error | `globals.state.bucket` | Present. |
| <span id="v-007"></span>V-007 | error | `tables.include` | Present and non-empty. |
| <span id="v-008"></span>V-008 | error | `source.host` | Resolvable (pipeline or defaults). |
| <span id="v-009"></span>V-009 | error | `source.db` | Resolvable. |

| <span id="v-011"></span>V-011 | error | `source.postgres.{publication,slot}` | Present when type=postgres. |
